The House met at eleven of the clock, Mr. 
Chairman in the Chair 
REFERENCE TO THE TRAGIC DEATH OF A SITTING MEMBER OF 
THE LOK SABHA 
MR. CHAIRMAN: Hon, Members, as all of you are aware, Shrimati 
Phoolan Devi, a sitting Member of the Lok Sabha, was brutally murdered in New 
Delhi on 25th July, 2001. 
As a mark of respect to the memory of Shrimati Phoolan Devi and also 
to enable Members to participate in the funeral, the House stands adjourned till 
11.00 a.m. on Friday, the 27th  July, 2001. 
The House then adjourned at one minute past eleven of the clock, till eleven of 
the clock on Friday, the 27th July, 2001.
